scripts.build:screensaver: vite build --config screensaver/vite.config.mjs && node screensaver/scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/stamp-release.mjs && node screensaver/scripts/build-zip.mjs
scripts.build:native:windows: npm run build:screensaver && npm run build:native:assets && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File native/windows-scr/build.ps1
scripts.build:native:macos: npm run build:screensaver && npm run build:native:assets && bash native/macos-saver/build.sh
